anya: Quick sanity check: on orion-v2 q5 path we see furigana (ruby) detached from kanji when detokenizing; translations lose the ruby content :eyes:

chen: Can you paste inputs + tokenization outputs?

anya: Repro input:
彼女は東京（とうきょう）に行った。

anya: float32 tokenization ->
```
['彼', '女', 'は', '東京', '（', 'とうきょう', '）', 'に', '行', 'った', '。']
```
anya: q5 quantized detok ->
```
['彼', '女', 'は', '東京', '（', 'とうきょう', '）', 'に', '行った', '。']
```
anya: float32 detok = "彼女は東京（とうきょう）に行った。"  q5 detok = "彼女は東京に行った。" (ruby disappeared)

samir: Is this a tokenizer regression or the kernel selection? Any build or vocab diffs?

anya: Tokenizer version is identical (v3.2.1). Bisect points at kernel selection: q5 picks KERNEL_V2 path, f32 uses KERNEL_V1. eval-bot logs show token id mapping shift on prefix merges.

eval-bot: Auto-eval: ja->en BLEU delta -1.4 on small set; 12/120 samples lost ruby annotations on q5.

marco: Can you run the HF tokenizer locally (no runtime kernels) to double-check detok? e.g. `tokenizer.encode(..., add_special_tokens=False)`

anya: local hf tokens match f32. Suspect runtime detok postprocess step strips parenthetical ruby when merge happens. Small repro script posted: `scripts/repro_furigana_q5.py` (shared in thread)

chen: Also flagging a related RTL case: when Arabic suffixes are adjacent to CJK punctuation we saw reordering on q5 detok a few weeks ago — could be same postprocess heuristic on punctuation spacing.

anya: Action items:
- samir: try forcing KERNEL_V1 for q5 path and rerun quick eval (30m)
- chen: audit detok tokens->string rules around parentheses/ruby and RTL punctuation
- marco: run full eval suite (veridian-lite + orion-v2 q5) and post BLEU regressions

samir: I'll kick off kernel switch now, will post logs. :coffee:

anya: Thanks all. If kernel switch fixes it we can patch kernel selector and ship a canary. :thumbsup:
